configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server to display in the server list

configurationFields.label: Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets the welcome message to display to players when joining. Use '/r' to split over multiple lines

configurationFields.label: Server Location
configurationFields.description: Sets information about the server location

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that can connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Server Bandwidth
configurationFields.description: Sets the server bandwidth

configurationFields.label: Enable Remote Admin
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the [remote admin](http://forum.mx-bikes.com/index.php?topic=3891.0) server will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Remote Admin Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to remote admin. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Client Ping Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the ping limit for clients. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Disable Polls
configurationFields.description: If set, polls will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Polls Disable During Races
configurationFields.description: If set, polls will be disabled during races

configurationFields.label: Results Export Format
configurationFields.description: Specifies the format for exporting results. If set, it will automatically export results at the end of the last session

configurationFields.label: Results Export Units
configurationFields.description: Specifies the units for exporting results

configurationFields.label: Results Filename Prefix
configurationFields.description: Sets the filename prefix for exported results

configurationFields.label: Export Incremental Results
configurationFields.description: If enabled, results will be exported at the end of each session

configurationFields.label: Export Contacts Mode
configurationFields.description: Specifies the contacts to include in the exported results

options.2: Contacts between bikes and with walls

configurationFields.label: Automatically Save Replays
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will automatically save the full replay at the end of the race

configurationFields.label: Replay Filename Prefix
configurationFields.description: Sets the filename prefix for saved replays

configurationFields.label: Live Data Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the [live timing](http://forum.mx-bikes.com/index.php?topic=233.0) mode

configurationFields.label: Live Data Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the Live Port. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Live Data Filename
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the file to write live timing data to, if the relevant Live Timing Mode is set

configurationFields.label: Live Data Track Position
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the track centreline and all bike positions will be written to the live timing data file, if the relevant Live Timing Mode is set

configurationFields.label: Live Data Contacts Mode
configurationFields.description: Specifies the contacts to write to the live timing data file, if the relevant Live Timing Mode is set

options.2: Contacts between bikes and with walls

configurationFields.label: Event Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the event

configurationFields.label: Tracks Shuffle Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the tracks shuffle mode

configurationFields.label: Track Settings
configurationFields.description: The selected tracks for an event, and their attributes such as layout and paint, can be specified in the [event] section of 'dedicated.ini'. Up to 10 tracks can be specified by a unique number, such as 'track2'

configurationFields.label: Allowed Bike Categories
configurationFields.description: Sets the allowed bike categories. Empty = Open. Multiple categories can be set, separated by a slash, such as: MX1/MX2

configurationFields.label: Allowed Bikes
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of IDs of allowed bikes, separated by a slash. For example: 350xf/450xf

configurationFields.label: Rating Class
configurationFields.description: Sets the rating class

configurationFields.label: Enable Open Practice
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the identified race settings following will be ignored

configurationFields.label: Replace Qualify Race
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the qualify race will be replaced by a qualify practice session, and the pre-qualify session will be skipped

configurationFields.label: Enable Quick Race
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the sighting lap and all sessions except for Warm-up and Race 2 will be skipped

configurationFields.label: Practice Session Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of the practice session. 0 = skipped

configurationFields.label: Pre-qualify Session Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of the pre-qualify session. 0 = skipped

configurationFields.label: Qualify Practice Session Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of the qualify practice session. 0 = skipped

configurationFields.label: Warmup Session Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of the warmup session. 0 = skipped

configurationFields.label: Enable Sighting Lap
configurationFields.description: If set, the sighting lap will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Race Length Format
configurationFields.description: Specifies the format for race length

configurationFields.label: Race Length Percentage
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of a full length for the race length, if the relevant Race Length Format is selected

configurationFields.label: Race Length Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of a timed race, if the relevant Race Length Format is selected

configurationFields.label: Race Length Extra Laps
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of extra laps for timed races, if the relevant Race Length Format is selected

configurationFields.label: Race Length Laps
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of laps for lap-based races

configurationFields.label: Restart Delay
configurationFields.description: Sets the server restart time. 0 = no restart

configurationFields.label: Race Over Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the race over length

configurationFields.label: Enable Event Pause
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the event will be paused and saved at the end of the specified Event Pause Session

configurationFields.label: Event Pause Session
configurationFields.description: Sets the session after which the event will be paused and saved, if Event Pause is enabled

configurationFields.label: Resume Event Filename
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the file to load to resume an event

configurationFields.label: Enable Event Save
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the event will be saved at the end of the specified Event Save Session. If Event Pause is enabled, this setting will be ignored

configurationFields.label: Event Save Session
configurationFields.description: Sets the session after which the event will be saved, if Event Save is enabled (and Event Pause is disabled)

configurationFields.label: Enable Realistic Weather
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the weather will be realistic, and the following weather settings will be ignored

configurationFields.label: Weather Conditions
configurationFields.description: Sets the weather conditions. Ignored if Realistic Weather is enabled

configurationFields.label: Weather Temperature
configurationFields.description: Sets the air temperature. Ignored if Realistic Weather is enabled

configurationFields.label: Wind Direction
configurationFields.description: Sets the wind direction. Ignored if Realistic Weather is enabled

configurationFields.label: Wind Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the wind speed. Ignored if Realistic Weather is enabled

configurationFields.label: Track Conditions
configurationFields.description: Sets the track conditions. Ignored if Realistic Weather is enabled

configurationFields.label: Force Cockpit
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the cockpit view will be forced

configurationFields.label: Disable Aids
configurationFields.description: If enabled, no driving aids will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Limit Tyre Sets
configurationFields.description: If enabled, tyre sets will be limited

configurationFields.label: Ban For Roost Changes
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players having their roost removed/altered will be banned for cheating

configurationFields.label: Ban For Tear-off Changes
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players having their tear-offs removed/altered will be banned for cheating

configurationFields.label: Force Lean Help
configurationFields.description: If enabled, connected players will be forced to 'leanhelp=1'

configurationFields.label: Reset Delay Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the bike reset delay mode

options.2: Reset delay based on distance of rider from bike
options.3: Reset delay based on distance of crash speed

configurationFields.label: Reset Delay Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the reset delay time, if the Reset Delay Mode is set to 'Fixed time reset delay'

configurationFields.label: Disable Collisions
configurationFields.description: If sets, collisions between bikes will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Collision Ping Limit
configurationFields.description: Set the ping over which collisions will be disabled (but high-ping clients will still collide with low-ping ones). 0 = collisions are never disabled

configurationFields.label: Deformation Scale
configurationFields.description: Sets the terrain deformation scale. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Deformation Auto Reset
configurationFields.description: If enabled, terrain deformation will be reset at the beginning of each session

configurationFields.label: Disable Dynamic Track Surfaces
configurationFields.description: If set, dynamic track surfaces will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Persistent Dynamic Track Surfaces
configurationFields.description: If enabled, dynamic track surfaces will not be reset between events

configurationFields.label: Disable Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, chat (except for admin messages) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Download Source
configurationFields.description: Sets how to download the client and server files. Standalone = complete download from the mirror set under Standalone Download Mirror. Steam with patch = client files downloaded from Steam, along with server patch downloaded from MX-Bikes.com. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting!

configurationFields.label: Standalone Download Mirror
configurationFields.description: Sets the mirror to download the client and server files from, if "Standalone" is selected under Download Source. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting!

deploymentSteps.name: 7-Zip Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path '7-Zip'; if (Test-Path '7z.exe') { exit 0 } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-x64.exe' -OutFile '7z-installer.exe' }; if ($?) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7zr.exe' -OutFile '7zr.exe' }; if ($?) { & ./7zr.exe x -y -aoa 7z-installer.exe *> $null 2>&1; Remove-Item -Path '7z-installer.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }"

deploymentSteps.name: MX Bikes Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && ServerDownloadMirror=\"{SERVERDOWNLOADMIRROR}\"; if [ \"$ServerDownloadMirror\" = \"MXB-Mods.com\" ]; then DownloadLink=$(wget -qO- \"https://betas.mxb-mods.com/\" | grep -o \"files/mxbikes[^\\\"]*\.exe\" | head -n 1) && wget --header=\"Referer: https://betas.mxb-mods.com/download/\" -qO mxbikes-beta.exe \"https://betas.mxb-mods.com/$DownloadLink\"; else DownloadLink=$(wget -qO- \"https://www.mx-bikes.com/?page=downloads\" | grep -o \"downloads/mxbikes[^\\\"]*\.exe\" | head -n 1) && wget -qO mxbikes-beta.exe \"https://www.mx-bikes.com/$DownloadLink\"; fi"

deploymentSteps.name: MX Bikes Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'server'; $ServerDownloadMirror='{SERVERDOWNLOADMIRROR}'; if ($ServerDownloadMirror -eq 'MXB-Mods.com') { $html = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://betas.mxb-mods.com/'; $DownloadLink = ($html.Links | Where-Object href -like 'files/mxbikes*.exe')[0].href; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://betas.mxb-mods.com/$DownloadLink\" -OutFile 'mxbikes-beta.exe' -Headers @{ Referer = 'https://betas.mxb-mods.com/download/' } } else { $html = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://www.mx-bikes.com/?page=downloads'; $DownloadLink = ($html.Links | Where-Object href -like 'downloads/mxbikes*.exe')[0].href; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://www.mx-bikes.com/$DownloadLink\" -OutFile 'mxbikes-beta.exe' }"
